response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_records, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') ORDER BY batting_hand
